description: This file handles the deletion of inventory items (devices) from a project inventory management system within the TestLink testing framework. It initializes request arguments, checks user permissions, performs the deletion, and returns a JSON response indicating success or failure.

classes.name: tlInventory
classes.description: A class managing inventory operations, such as deleting inventory items.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic PHP class used here to store dynamic properties for arguments.

methods.name: deleteInventory
methods.description: Deletes a specified inventory item (device) identified by machineID.

methods.name: getUserFeedback
methods.description: Returns a message string indicating the result of the last operation.

methods.name: hasRight
methods.description: Checks if the user has the specified permission.
